cohort: 82,793 singleton pregnancies in the Aarhus Birth Cohort (1989-2013), including 1,719 pregnancies in women with endometriosis
finding: Women with endometriosis were at increased risk of pre-eclampsia, preterm birth, and cesarean section, independent of assisted reproductive technology use.
mod_finding: Women with endometriosis were at increased risk of cesarean section, irrespective of use of assisted reproductive technology.
